Room Detail Check Available Eat & Drink Crystal Jade Palace Step into a world of exquisite Cantonese flavors and elegant dining at Crystal Jade Palace, located within the luxurious Rey Hotel Hanoi. Our master chefs meticulously craft each dish using traditional techniques and the finest ingredients, creating a symphony of tastes and textures that will tantalize your palate. From delicate dim sum to succulent Peking duck, our menu showcases the rich culinary heritage of Cantonese cuisine. Experience a truly unforgettable dining experience amidst the refined ambiance of Crystal Jade Palace. Dining with us Eat & Drink MOJO Cafe & Bistro Escape the city buzz and step into the relaxed sophistication of MOJO Cafe & Bistro, nestled within Rey Hotel Hanoi. Bathed in natural light and radiating urban chic, MOJO is your go-to for delicious escapes throughout the day. Start your morning with aromatic Vietnamese coffee and a tempting pastry, fuel up with a flavorful lunch, or unwind over evening cocktails as the city lights twinkle. With friendly service and a menu that blends international favorites and local delicacies, MOJO Cafe & Bistro is your perfect Hanoi hangout.
